settings.heading: Sofa Safety Guidelines
settings.body_text: We want your sofa to stay comfortable and looking great for years to come. These guidelines cover the simple things you can do to keep your furniture safe, well-maintained, and in the best possible shape for everyday use.

settings.heading: All Sofa Direct Upholstery
settings.body:
Genuine Leather Sofas · Bonded Leather Sofas · Leather Aire Sofas · Fabric Sofas (Various Fabric Types) · Electric and Manual Recliners.

Built for comfort, durability, and everyday use with quality materials and reliable recliner mechanisms.

settings.title: UK Fire Safety Compliance
settings.text: All Sofa Direct upholstered furniture meets the requirements of the Furniture and Furnishings (Fire) (Safety) Regulations 1988, as amended.
settings.list1:
Leave all permanent fire safety labels exactly where they are
Never swap out original cushion fillings for non-compliant alternatives
Keep your sofa well away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, portable heaters, and direct heat sources

settings.title: Safe Placement
settings.text: Where you put your sofa matters more than you might think — the right spot keeps it safer and helps it last longer.
settings.list1:
At least 30 cm away from radiators or any direct heat source
On a firm, flat, and stable surface
Out of prolonged direct sunlight to prevent fading or drying
Away from damp or high-moisture areas unless well ventilated

settings.title: Weight & Everyday Use
settings.text: Your sofa is built for sitting on — using it properly keeps it comfortable, shapely, and safe.
settings.list1:
Standing, kneeling, or jumping on cushions
Putting excessive weight on armrests or backrests
Letting children climb on sofas or treat them as play equipment

settings.title: Moving & Handling
settings.text: A little care when moving your sofa protects both the furniture and your floors.
settings.list1:
Always lift your sofa — never drag it
Use at least two people for larger pieces
Remove or secure detachable parts (feet, cushions, accessories)
Use floor protection to avoid scratches

settings.title: Recliner Mechanisms
settings.text: Recliner sofas are great — just use the moving parts sensibly.
settings.list1:
Don't put hands, feet or any objects in moving parts
Never leave children alone to use mechanisms
Use the mechanism and make sure it's completely shut before moving the sofa
If it is difficult or feels odd, don't use it and ask an expert
